chunks.arabic_text: ١٨ - مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَوْرَمَةَ، أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، الْقُمِّيُّ.

translations.en: 18 – Muhammad ibn Awrama, Abu Ja'far, al-Qummi.

chunks.arabic_text: اتَّهَمَهُ الْقُمِّيُّونَ بِالْغُلُوِّ، وَحَدِيثُهُ نَقِيٌّ لَا فَسَادَ فِيهِ، وَمَا رَأَيْتُ شَيْئًا يُنْسَبُ إِلَيْهِ تَضْطَرِبُ فِيهِ النَّفْسُ، إِلَّا أَوْرَاقًا فِي "تَفْسِيرِ الْبَاطِنِ" وَمَا يَلِيقُ بِحَدِيثِهِ، وَأَظُنُّهَا مُوْضَعَةً عَلَيْهِ. وَرَأَيْتُ "كِتَابًا" خَرَجَ مِنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ، عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ (عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ) إِلَى الْقُمِّيِّينَ فِي بَرَاءَتِهِ مِمَّا قُذِفَ بِهِ (وَحَسَّنَ عَقِيدَتَهُ، وَقَرُبَ) مَنْزِلَتَهُ. وَقَدْ حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَنْدَارٍ، الْقُمِّيُّ (رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ) قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُشَايِخِي يَقُولُونَ: إِنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ أَوْرَمَةَ لَمَّا طُعِنَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْغُلُوِّ (اِتَّفَقَتْ) الْأَشَاعِرَةُ لِيَقْتُلُوهُ، فَوَجَدُوهُ يُصَلِّي اللَّيْلَ مِنْ أَوَّلِهِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ، لَيَالٍ عَدِيدًا، فَتَوَقَّفُوا عَنْ اِعْتِقَادِهِمْ.

translations.en: The Qummis accused him of ghulw (exaggeration), but his hadith are pure, there is no corruption in them. And I have not seen anything attributed to him that confounds the soul, except for pages in 'Tafsir al-Batin' and what befits his hadith, and I suspect they are a forgery upon him. And I saw a 'book' that came out from Abu al-Hasan, Ali ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) to the Qummis regarding his disassociation (bar'a) from what he was defamed with (and he praised his creed, and [mentioned the nearness] of his station). And al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Bundar, al-Qummi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me, he said: I heard my elders saying: When Muhammad ibn Awrama was accused of ghulw, the Asha'ira agreed to kill him, but they found him praying at night from its beginning to its end, for numerous nights, so they halted from their belief.

en.summary: This entry from al-Ghadā'irī’s *Kitāb al-Duʿafāʾ* defends Muhammad ibn Awrama against the Qummī accusation of *ghulw* (exaggeration) by highlighting the purity of his narrations and a specific epistle from Imam al-Ḥasan al-ʿAskarī. The narrative illustrates the practical validation of his orthodoxy, where his persistent night prayers (*qiyam*) convinced the Ashāʿira of his sincerity, thereby resolving the theological dispute through observable devotion.
en.seo_question: Who was Muhammad ibn Awrama and how was the accusation of ghulw against him resolved?
